other_failure_modes.name: Missing target transformation for monetary data
other_failure_modes.description: Monetary targets (like USD disbursements) are almost always heavily right-skewed. Training a model on raw, un-transformed monetary values usually results in poor performance because the loss function (RMSE) becomes overly dominated by a few massive outliers. A log transformation (e.g., log1p) is standard practice here but is missing.
